text:
support-tyler: customer alert - multiple 503s from hosted inference starting ~09:12 UTC. Several customers reporting timeouts, CS received high volume. trace_id: 0xabc123

ops-bot: incident opened: INC-2026-3542. alert group: hosted-api-503s

oncall: looking

sre-kate: seeing spike in 503s, ~90% from pool-us-west-gpu-1. Node restarts + container exits.

eng-nina: grabbing logs now. can someone paste a sample container stdout?

infra-raj: kube events from pool-us-west-gpu-1 pasted below:
```
Warning  OOMKILL  2m kubelet     Container killed due to OOM
kubelet: killing process 12345 (infer-runner) total-vm: 12Gi
```

eng-nina: stacktrace from container syslog:
```
infer-runner[12345]: CudaAssert: device-side assert triggered at aten/native/attn_kernel.cu:452
infer-runner: signal 6 (SIGABRT) - backtrace: 0x55f3...
```

sre-kate: matches GPU OOM followed by SIGABRT, immediate restart loop on container.

mira: this starts right after we rolled dynbatch config v2 at 09:07 — suspect batch expansion regression.

eng-nina: repro steps so far: 1) apply dynbatch v2, 2) send ~1k parallel requests with mixed contexts including some ~30k tokens, 3) observe OOM in ~30s; KV prefetch + batch expansion multiplies memory usage.

cs-ryan: impacted customer: ACME Corp prod streaming endpoints. They're asking for ETA and billing credits.

oncall: mitigation - routing traffic for ACME to fallback model variant (quantized, lower mem) for affected pool.

infra-raj: drained nodes in pool-us-west-gpu-1 and marked for debug; scaled up pool-us-west-gpu-2 by +2 nodes to absorb traffic.

eng-nina: short-term workaround: revert dynbatch to v1 thresholds and disable kv-prefetch for requests flagged as large-context. Patch ready: revert dynbatch multiplier and add config gate.

sre-kate: rolling rollback now, monitoring p95 and error rate.

ops-bot: deploy status: rollback started at 09:33 UTC -> success on 4/5 hosts, last host failing due to coredump retrieval (collecting core and nvml logs).

mira: note for postmortem: dynbatch assumed homogeneous short-context workload; mixed long contexts + toolcalls allowed batch multiplier to exceed device memory. Need safer guards.

eng-nina: attached reproducer and exact curl sequence to INC ticket. quick repro link: https://redwood.internal/INC-2026-3542/repro

cs-ryan: updated customer: routed to fallback, ETA ~20m for full recovery on their traffic, offered credits. keeping them in loop.

oncall: p95 error rate dropped from ~18% -> ~2% after rollback + scale. keeping incident open for 2 hours for validation.

sre-kate: next action items: (1) hard-limit batch expansion multiplier when long-contexts present, (2) mem-protection circuit to abort single requests that would cause batch > N GiB, (3) emit telemetry from dynbatch with projected mem estimate per-batch.

eng-nina: also updating model-onboarding tests to include mixed long/short contexts + toolcalls before dynbatch changes.

mira: creating postmortem doc and scheduling blameless review. will ping ops in 30m for notes.

support-tyler: thanks team — customer follow-up note drafted, will send once we confirm stable. :thumbsup:
